parameters.name: Cert
parameters.description: The non-China SM certificate content in PEM format.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

parameters.name: EncryptCert
parameters.description: The encryption certificate content of the China SM certificate in PEM format. This field is invalid when Cert and Key are not empty.

parameters.name: EncryptPrivateKey
parameters.description: The private key content of the encryption certificate of the China SM certificate in PEM format. This field is invalid when Cert and Key are not empty.

parameters.name: Key
parameters.description: The private key content of the non-China SM certificate in PEM format.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description:
The custom certificate name. Maximum length: 63 characters. All character types are supported, including letters, digits, and underscores.
> Certificate names must be unique within the same user account.

parameters.name: SignCert
parameters.description: The signing certificate content of the China SM certificate in PEM format. This field is invalid when Cert and Key are not empty.

parameters.name: SignPrivateKey
parameters.description: The private key content of the signing certificate of the China SM certificate in PEM format. This field is invalid when Cert and Key are not empty.
